name: mira-promo-video
description: Video tutorial Mira v3 (Remotion): UI direplikasi 1:1 dari landing-page/, narasi & SFX ElevenLabs.

scripts.mux: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/mira-tutorial-bisu.mp4 -i audio/mix-lengkap.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/mira-tutorial.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/mira-tutorial-bisu.mp4 -i audio/mix-tanpa-musik.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/mira-tutorial-tanpa-musik.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/mira-tutorial-bisu.mp4 -i audio/mix-tanpa-narasi.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/mira-tutorial-tanpa-narasi.mp4
scripts.semua: npm run render && npm run audio && npm run mux && npm run naskah && npm run posting
